Senior Frontend Engineer — Acme Logistics (Remote, UK)

What you will do:
- 5+ years' experience with React and TypeScript
- Comfortable mentoring junior engineers through code review
- Own the operator console used by dispatchers every day
- Solid grasp of accessibility and keyboard-first interfaces
- Familiarity with warehouse logistics or fleet routing is a plus

We are remote-first across the UK and write more than we talk. Our handbook is public.

Backend Engineer — Halstead Freight

We need someone to own our booking API. Node, Postgres, some queue work.

Data Engineer — Northwind Analytics (Bristol, hybrid)

Requirements:
- 3+ years building batch pipelines in Python
- SQL against messy, regulated healthcare data
- Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer
- Comfortable owning data quality checks end to end
- Nice to have: NHS or pharmacy domain exposure

Platform Engineer — Tessellate (Manchester)

Requirements:
- Kubernetes in production, not just in a tutorial
- Terraform for everything, reviewed like application code
- Comfortable carrying a pager on a shared on-call rotation
- Nice to have: experience migrating off a managed platform

Robotics Software Engineer — Vector Robotics (Eindhoven)

Requirements:
- Real-time control loops in C++ or Rust
- Motion planning for picking cells
- Comfortable owning safety-critical code review
- Python for tooling and test rigs
